steps.content: [Black Screen]
Thump.
This place of death... who does it claim...
Thump. Thump. Thump.
It gathers souls... forgets their name...
Rhythmic beats pulse through the darkness, ancient and sorrowful, as though crossing centuries to reach you. Each one lands like a stone dropped into deep water.

You force your eyes open. Fog clings thick, but through it, you glimpse figures in white at the far end, moving with the slowness of ritual. The foremost carries a white funeral banner that sways with each step as they chant.

They fade into the distance. Then the flakes begin. White and soft as snow, they drift onto your body, your face. You reach up, only to find ashes. Burnt paper offerings, crumbling between your fingers, scattering on the wind before you can hold them.
[Inner World]
The fog lifts, but this is not the Bureau's lounge. Above you stretches a sky the color of sickness: gray-green and heavy. Before you lies a barren earth twisted and crumbling.
You're back. Again.

But you remember leaving. You remember escaping those ruins, returning to the Bureau, and submitting to the full weight of their medical examination. Sleep deprivation, they said. Mild anemia. Nothing severe.

Schorl promised to find the records on <color=#fb9259>Maria City</color>, the place Shin named. And now, with a new Illusory Moon tidal cycle approaching, the Ring Research Institute has prepared to monitor.

You know the rhythm now: sleep brings the DisSea nightmare, pulled by the Illusory Moon's tide. But never like this, never so precise. Last time, you wandered through ruins to arrive. This time, you have fallen directly into the twisted, breathing depths where nightmare lives.
So... is this that woman's doing after all? As if hearing the thought, her laughter curls through your ears.
You shake your head, brow tight. You will not give her the satisfaction. No matter how many times it takes, you will leave. You will return to where you truly belong.

But the darkness has already heard your resolve. It answers with squirming movement. The aberrations you fled before have not forgotten your scent. The phantoms remember your shape. And tonight, they are more excited. More hungry than last time.
[Faint Red Light Flickering]
The whispers withdraw, but the darkness itself becomes a witness. From its depths, invisible eyes open because of you, because of something you did, something you still do not understand.
You clench your fist, feeling the power of the shackles in your palm. You must use your only weapon with care.
You recall the stele and the red Hypercube flowers at the dream's end. It functioned like a boundary marker. To escape again, you need to find another.
Tinkle...
As if in response, the distance answers. Crisp metallic chimes ring out, cutting through the quiet. You listen closer, and a melody takes shape.
If the melody springs from something like a bell, then fortune smiles. But fortune is a stranger here. It could also be a monster wearing the shape of music. You must stay vigilant.
You clench your fist, feeling the faint power of the shackles, and take a deep breath. Following the sound, you proceed with caution.
